name: Banh cong
summary: Bánh cống is a savoury fritter of mung bean, taro, and rice flour, topped with a whole shrimp. Eat two or three with herbs as an afternoon snack.
origin: Can Tho and Soc Trang. The snack is popular in both.
howToEat: Two or three, with herbs, in the afternoon.
seoDescription: A savoury fritter of mung bean, taro, and rice flour topped with a whole shrimp, popular in Can Tho and Soc Trang.
